title: Closing jobs at end of day (Lalamove, LLM, move-over)
keywords: close lalamove job close llm end of shift 11pm move-over file reverted file overtime
body: Close every Lalamove job the same day. Attach POD only if it was on time.
9.45pm: close all Lalamove jobs. 10–11pm: close all Lalamove and LLM jobs and any morning/afternoon jobs not yet closed.
End of day: update the Move-over and Reverted files.
11pm: every job is closed before the shift ends. At least 1 CS stays until all jobs are closed; anyone staying back is logged for OT.
